steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Ensure clauses are not globally mandatory.
Enable the event creation flow required by the case.
Allow the vendor to be added during event creation.
Set the event type to RFQ and use whole-lot awarding.
Provide the required event title.
Apply the available RFQ template so the pricing sheet is created.
Add the specified product and quantity.
Confirm the event contains one line item.
Set the requested delivery location in the pricing sheet.
Verify the delivery location was retained.

args.goal: on the single-stage RFQ create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", leave both clause modes as None, leave "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory" unticked, click Done, and stop on the create screen

steps.note: Add both optional clauses and verify the mandatory switch remains unticked.
Add one QA test vendor for Vendor A.
Commit the 30-minute schedule starting now.
Publish the configured RFQ.
Confirm the event was published and has a project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal session.
Open the event's RFQ pricing round as the vendor.
Confirm the first clause is shown to the vendor.
Confirm the second clause is shown to the vendor.
Accept the first optional clause.
Accept the second optional clause.
Quote 100 for the line and submit the vendor bid.
Verify the vendor portal reports the bid as submitted.
Return to the buyer's event page for the buyer-side result.
Confirm no error is shown after the vendor submission.
